intro.title: Build user signup login endpoints
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Node.js API with two endpoints: one for user signup and one for user login. You will learn how to handle HTTP POST requests using the Express framework to receive and process user data, such as email and password. The core programming concept involves creating route handlers that manage request and response objects to validate input and return appropriate JSON messages. You'll use essential Node.js constructs like Express routing, middleware for parsing JSON, and basic conditional logic to simulate user authentication.
intro.usecase: User signup and login endpoints are the foundational authentication layer for virtually any web application that requires user accounts. You'll implement these endpoints when building features like registration forms for e-commerce sites, login screens for social media platforms, or secure access panels for banking dashboards. As a Node.js developer, you'll frequently create these RESTful endpoints to handle user credentials, manage sessions, and protect sensitive data across different client applications.
